proven: The handoff digest is deterministic for identical authoritative inputs.
The handoff binds exact workflow, plan, Book project and source manuscript identities.
The handoff target is fixed to SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK content-object admission and commitContentAdmission; caller target or actor override fails closed.
Only workflow state READY_FOR_ADMISSION_HANDOFF with a single READY terminal Book admission task may produce a handoff.
Every required admission ancestor must be COMPLETED; failed, blocked, cancelled or running required predecessors fail closed.
The exact Phase-2I evidence chain is validated and required predecessor evidence coverage is enforced.
Author authority is represented only by explicit AUTHOR_DECISION_REFERENCE_OBSERVED decision references and ambiguous or missing author evidence fails closed.
The candidate must be a workflow specialist output with exact provenance from a completed PROSE.GENERATE_REVISION_CANDIDATE result receipt.
Evaluator output cannot masquerade as candidate-generation authority.
Candidate bytes and raw manuscript/candidate text are excluded; candidate identity is reference plus SHA-256 digest.
Expected parent Book state version and digest are bound directly from the workflow source identity and stale current source fails closed.
The handoff contains no content-admission operations, exposes no admission commit/execute API and always has canonical_effect_allowed=false.
COMPLETED_NO_CHANGE cannot be converted into an admission handoff.
non_claims: The existing Book content-admission entrypoint was observed but not executed by this qualification.
No provider execution or provider retry occurred.
No durable persistence or crash-survival storage guarantee was proven.
No fresh blind scoring or evaluator-isolation qualification occurred.
No A-01 target qualification PASS is claimed or transferred to this 2J software subject.
